# Issued Project Requirements — Mechanical Services

**Project:** Civic Learning Centre Fit-out  
**Issue:** Issued for coordination, Rev 0

## Mechanical requirements

1. Provide two independently supported toilet exhaust systems. Each fan shall be rated for **2.0 kW maximum connected load** and shall include a local isolator.
2. Maintain minimum 8 air changes per hour in the accessible washroom. Verify final airflow during commissioning.
3. Coordinate roof penetrations with the architectural reflected ceiling plan and structural framing before release of shop drawings.

The equipment schedule and coordination plan are to be read together. Where a later issued revision expressly changes a requirement, the later revision governs only the identified item.
